shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic reference (a head/face in A; the pillar body implied in B)
strongly simplified, reductive carving of living forms
eye rendered as a simple carved ovoid/ridge
justification: A depicts a single frontal human head with brow ridges, nose and mouth reduced to broad planes, while B depicts stacked registers of profile animals (quadrupeds, long-necked birds, a serpentine form) separated by a zigzag/net band, so almost no depicted subject is shared beyond a general habit of extreme schematisation. The only real correspondence is the reductive, geometricising treatment of living forms; the biggest difference is frontal single human face versus a multi-register animal frieze with no face at all.
